burst: Affects 1 incapacitated ally unit(s) with the highest final ATK. Resurrect with 81.67% HP.
Activates when HP falls below 30%. Affects all enemies. Stun for 1 sec.

caveats: ⚑ skill1 trigger: the kit says "when performing a Full Charge attack"; the schema has no full-charge trigger, so it is keyed to shotFired on the premise that every RL trigger pull in the sim is a full charge (chargeFrames 60). If the engine ever fires uncharged shots, this over-fires the recovery event.

⚑ skill2 carries NO activation clause but a 15 s duration, so its real re-trigger cadence is unknown; modeled as a one-shot passive at t=0 with durationSec 15. Both of its stats are offensively inert here (ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct; incoming-healing has no StatKey), so the choice moves no damage — but it must be pinned before any HP-scaling consumer is added.

⚑ cadence tuple (ammo 6 / reloadFrames 159 / chargeFrames 60) is datamined and unreliable; it sets how often skill1's recovery event fires, which is the load-bearing output of this kit for on-recovery consumers.

Heal MAGNITUDES (4.03% / 40.83% of caster final Max HP) are not represented — the heal effect emits recovery events with no HP amount, which is the whole of its damage-relevant function (firing teammates' recovery triggers).
This unit contributes no damage of its own; its entire sim value is the recovery-event stream plus burst-gauge/rotation participation as a Burst I.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Rapunzel is a pure sustain Supporter (RL/Iron/Burst I) with zero damage lines. skill1 emits a recovery event to the 3 lowest-HP allies on each full-charge shot (kept, not skipped, because on-recovery consumers such as Crown-style kits key off it). skill2 grants the 2 highest-final-ATK allies targetMaxHpPct 8.19% for 15 s; its incoming-healing line has no StatKey and is unmodeled. The burst emits a recovery event to all allies on cast. Resurrect and the sub-30%-HP stun are unmodeled: v1 has no HP pool (nobody is incapacitated, no HP threshold can be crossed) and the boss has no fire/charge/reload state for a stun to suppress.

audit.kitLine: Activates when performing a Full Charge
audit.effectOrReason: trigger {kind:'shotFired'} — no full-charge trigger exists in the schema; every RL pull is treated as a full charge (⚑)

audit.kitLine: Affects the 3 ally with lowest HP percent
audit.effectOrReason: target {kind:'alliesLowestHp', count:3} — resolves to the leftmost 3 allies as the documented v1 stand-in (no HP pool)

audit.kitLine: Recovers 4.03% of user Max HP as HP
audit.effectOrReason: {kind:'heal'} — emits one recovery event per fire; HP amount is not modeled by the schema

audit.kitLine: Affects 2 ally with highest final ATK
audit.effectOrReason: target {kind:'alliesTopAtk', count:2, byFinalAtk:true} — kit says "final ATK", so live-ATK ranking per the literal-word rule
buff targetMaxHpPct 8.19, durationSec 15 (target's OWN Max HP, not caster-scaled); trigger is kit-silent → passive (⚑)
No StatKey for incoming-healing multipliers and no HP amounts are modeled, so the stat has no consumer anywhere in the engine; recorded verbatim in unmodeled.skill2
target {kind:'allies'} (self included — kit says "all allies", no except-self clause)

audit.kitLine: Recovers 40.83% of user Max HP as HP
audit.effectOrReason: {kind:'heal'} on trigger {kind:'burstCast'} — one team-wide recovery event per own-burst cast
v1 models no HP pool and the boss deals no damage, so no unit is ever incapacitated — the branch is unreachable, and no schema kind expresses resurrection; verbatim in unmodeled.burst

audit.kitLine: HP below 30% → all enemies Stun 1 sec
audit.effectOrReason: Doubly inert: TriggerDef has no HP-threshold trigger (no HP pool, threshold never crosses) and a stun only suppresses fire/charge/reload, which the boss has no state for; verbatim in unmodeled.burst

flags.estimate: {kind:'shotFired'} — one recovery event per trigger pull (≈ every charge cycle: 60 charge frames + release latency, 6-round magazine, 159-frame reload)
flags.reasoning: The kit gates skill1 on a Full Charge attack, but TriggerDef has no full-charge kind. shotFired is correct only if the sim always full-charges this RL; chargeCounter{count:1} was rejected because its per-phase cycling semantics expect one effect per phase and would mis-fire with a single effect.
flags.recipe: Instrument a controlComp run with cfg.onEvent, count kind:'shot' events for rapunzel over 180 s, and compare against the charge-release cadence in the rotation log; if any shot is released uncharged, re-key to a charge-gated trigger or add a swapGate/fbGate equivalent.

flags.estimate: {kind:'passive'} applied once at frame 0 with durationSec 15 (i.e. live t=0–15 s only)
flags.reasoning: The kit prose carries a 15 s duration with NO activation clause, which is the kit-silent-trigger ALWAYS-⚑ case. A true passive would be permanent (over-credit); an interval{sec:15} would leave t=0–15 uncovered (under-credit). Both stats are offensively inert under the e3 ally-Max-HP rule, so the choice is currently damage-neutral.
flags.recipe: Re-read the unredacted in-game skill-2 text for the stripped activation clause (most NIKKE 15 s support lines key to burstCast or fullBurstEnter); if a clause exists, key the block to it. Otherwise leave passive and revisit only when an HP-scaling consumer (atkOfMaxHpPct) is added to a teammate.

flags.estimate: Datamined values used as-is: ~1 s charge, 6-round magazine, ~2.65 s reload
flags.reasoning: rate_of_fire / reloadFrames are the known-unreliable datamine fields, and here they set the ONLY load-bearing output of this kit — how many recovery events skill1 emits per fight for on-recovery consumers.
flags.recipe: Count rapunzel shot events per 180 s in a controlComp run and check against footage ammo-counter timing (shots/sec measured directly, not inferred from a downstream quantity).

flags.estimate: Amount not modeled; each heal emits a single recovery event (ticks defaults to 1)
flags.reasoning: Neither kit line is a heal-over-time ("Recovers X% … as HP" with no per-second clause), so ticks:1 is the faithful shape; the % of caster Max HP has no consumer because no HP pool exists.
flags.recipe: If a teammate's on-recovery buff ever proves to scale with heal SIZE rather than heal COUNT, the heal effect needs an amount field before this unit can drive it — record the consumer's popup values across a small vs large heal to test.
